chapters.focus: Retain Thou/Thee/Thine and the matching second-person forms in direct prayer; modernize third-person verbs and ordinary address to despisers. Render Thou hast appointed at 1:12 to reflect the perfect result and Thou wilt not be able to at 1:13 to make the future explicit. Preserve the judge takes without a supplied object, scattered law, despisers/vanish, Chaldean warriors, wolves of Arabia, tyrants as toys, spirit/propitiation/my God, He formed me/his discipline, fish/creeping things, distinct fishing nets, choice foods and continual killing.

chapters.focus: Modernize ordinary address and third-person forms; nest the short quotation at 2:6 within the outer speech.
